lore: Word has come that every island in the census has a smuggler skiff running for the harbour tonight. They come up the winding channel one after another, two ticks apart. Boom-master Leopold has only two boom posts. Each one snags the skiff nearest the harbour within its reach and tears at its hull. Choose the sites so the fewest skiffs reach the quay.

lines.watertight: No better pair of posts on the whole chart. The harbour sleeps sound tonight.
lines.leaky: Some got through that needn't have. Reach isn't everything; think about when they arrive.
lines.overrun: Every skiff slipped past. Put the posts where the channel bends back on itself.
